{{Quote|It tastes like ibbot.|A common Drallish sentiment|<ref name="CatCW" />}}
The '''common ibbot''', also known as the '''brown ibbot''', was one of sixty-eight [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[ibbot]] [[Bird/Legends|bird]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drall (planet)|Drall]]. Though it initially evolved to fill a particular role in Drall's ecosystem, the common ibbot was eventually domesticated by Drall's [[Drall/Legends|natives]] in order to supplement their [[Diet/Legends|diet]]. The bird could be prepared in many different ways and tasted mild and slightly [[Salt/Legends|salty]] when eaten. Members of the Drall [[Species/Legends|species]] often described off-world [[Foodstuff/Legends|foods]] as tasting like ibbot.<ref name="CatCW" />

==Behind the scenes==
The common ibbot was mentioned in the [[2003]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebook ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="CatCW" />
